title: Scanner Route Prep
summary: Scan first. Move second. Regret less.
body: Scanner leads point toward signal, salvage, danger, or all three wearing one coat.
Use HoloMap after scanning so distance, hazards, and exits are visible before you leave.
steps: Use the scanner near your staging point.
Open HoloMap and compare route markers.
Bring filters, water, and spare power.
commonMistakes: Ignoring cold, toxic, or radiation overlays.
